# Octaloop

> Octaloop is an India-based marketing agency for B2B tech and SaaS, fintech, AI and Web3 brands: AEO (answer engine optimisation), PR, paid ads and events. Octaloop also runs India Blockchain Tour and Metamorphosis.

## Services
- [AEO](https://octaloop.com/aeo/): Getting brands named and cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
- [PR](https://octaloop.com/pr/): Earned media for tech brands: bylines, features and roundup placements.
- [Events](https://octaloop.com/events/): India Blockchain Tour (26 City Stops since 2016) and Metamorphosis, India's Premier Web3 x AI Gala.
- [Past events](https://octaloop.com/past-events/)
- [Contact](https://octaloop.com/contact-us/)

## Guides
- [Metamorphosis'26 Recap: India's Web3 x AI Summit in Hyderabad](https://octaloop.com/blog/metamorphosis-2026-hyderabad-recap/): T-Hub, 26–27 Sep 2026: speakers, partners, themes and what five editions taught us about growing a tech event.
- [Digital PR for AEO: How Earned Media Gets You Cited by AI](https://octaloop.com/blog/digital-pr-for-aeo/): Which publications AI engines cite, and a step-by-step digital PR plan for B2B SaaS.
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: What a B2B SaaS Founder Actually Needs to Know](https://octaloop.com/blog/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo/): Definitions, comparison table and which to prioritise by stage.
- [How to Get Your SaaS Mentioned in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews](https://octaloop.com/blog/get-saas-mentioned-in-chatgpt-perplexity-ai-overviews/): The Octaloop Citation Loop: baseline, extractable pages, earned mentions, entity accuracy, re-measure.
